title: 熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕与森林的悄悄话
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol12/Vol12_晚读讲义_熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕与森林的悄悄话_v1.pdf
pdfName: Vol12_晚读讲义_熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕与森林的悄悄话_v1.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! This is our twelfth show together! Today we fly to a zoo in Berlin, where two birthday girls share one very cold cake. Then we tiptoe into a forest, where the trees are whispering under the ground. Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！这是我们在一起的第十二期节目啦！今天我们先飞到柏林的一家动物园，两位过生日的小寿星要分享一块超冷的蛋糕。然后我们踮起脚尖走进一片森林，那里的树木正在地底下说悄悄话。出发吧！

blocks.en: Happy birthday, Leni and Lotti! The twin sisters are giant pandas at Berlin Zoo. For their second birthday, their keepers made them a cake — a cake of ice! It had three tiers, pink and orange, coloured with beetroot and carrot juice. On top sat little flowers carved from carrots. No candles — pandas like presents frozen.
blocks.title: 熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕
blocks.cn: 生日快乐，莲妮和洛蒂！这对双胞胎姐妹是柏林动物园的大熊猫。她们两岁生日时，饲养员为她们做了一个蛋糕——一个冰做的蛋糕！它有三层，粉粉的、橙橙的，是用甜菜根和胡萝卜汁染的颜色。顶上还坐着用胡萝卜雕出来的小花。没有蜡烛——熊猫就喜欢冻起来的礼物。

blocks.en: The sisters wasted no time. They nibbled the carrot flowers, pawed at the ice, and chased each other around the garden. The crowd erupted in cheers; the cameras clicked and clicked. The children at the glass had eyes round as saucers.
blocks.title: 熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕
blocks.cn: 姐妹俩一分钟都没耽误。她们小口啃着胡萝卜花，用爪子拨弄冰块，还在园子里你追我赶。人群爆发出欢呼声，相机咔嚓咔嚓响个不停。玻璃前的小朋友们眼睛瞪得像碟子一样圆。

blocks.en: At the start, the twins were tiny — born blind, almost hairless, small enough to sleep in a keeper's hand. Leni weighed just one hundred and thirty-six grams — about as much as an apple! Today, each sister weighs more than fifty kilos. Their parents, Meng Meng and Jiao Qing, came from Chengdu, China — the second pair of panda twins ever born in Germany.
blocks.title: 熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕
blocks.cn: 最开始的时候，双胞胎小得不得了——出生时眼睛看不见，几乎没有毛，小到能在饲养员的手心里睡觉。莲妮只有一百三十六克——差不多一个苹果那么重！如今，姐妹俩每个都超过五十公斤了。她们的爸爸妈妈梦梦和娇庆来自中国成都——这对双胞胎是德国出生的第二对大熊猫双胞胎。

blocks.en: Every panda birthday is a party for conservation: pandas were once in great danger, and each healthy baby shows the hard work is working. Happy birthday, Leni and Lotti — may your cake always be cold!
blocks.title: 熊猫姐妹的冰蛋糕
blocks.cn: 每一次熊猫过生日，都是为自然保护开的一场派对：大熊猫曾经处境非常危险，而每一个健康的熊猫宝宝都在告诉世界——保护它们的努力没有白费。生日快乐，莲妮和洛蒂——愿你们的蛋糕永远冰冰凉凉！

blocks.en: Now tiptoe into the forest. Above the ground, birds sing among the leaves; below the ground, something amazing is happening. Almost every tree is plugged into a secret network — not of wires, but of fungi: tiny threads, thinner than hair, wrapping root tips in soft nets, like little capsules of cotton.
blocks.title: 森林的悄悄话
blocks.cn: 现在踮起脚尖走进森林。地面上，小鸟在树叶间唱歌；地面下，神奇的事情正在发生。几乎每一棵树都接入了一张秘密网络——不是电线织成的网，而是真菌的网：细细的丝线，比头发还细，把树根尖裹进柔软的网里，像一颗颗小小的棉花胶囊。

blocks.en: Through it, trees trade: fungi carry water and minerals up, and trees pay with sugar from their leaves. Nobody gets everything, but everybody gets enough. That is a compromise — a fair deal written in sugar and water.
blocks.title: 森林的悄悄话
blocks.cn: 通过这张网，树木做起了交易：真菌把水和矿物质送上来，树木用叶子制造的糖来付款。谁也拿不到全部，但谁都够用。这就是一种妥协——一笔用糖和水写成的公平交易。

blocks.en: Scientists observed the forest for years to determine what else moves below ground. When insects attack one tree, it sends a warning through the network — a warning relevant to every neighbour: "Make your leaves bitter — the hungry bugs are coming!" Mother trees turn up the dial and send extra sugar to their seedlings.
blocks.title: 森林的悄悄话
blocks.cn: 科学家观察了这片森林好多年，想弄清楚地下还在传递些什么。当昆虫攻击一棵树时，它会通过网络发出警告——这个警告和每一个邻居都息息相关：“把你们的叶子变苦——贪吃的虫子要来啦！”大树妈妈还会把“旋钮”拧大，给自己的小树苗多送一些糖。

blocks.en: Is the forest really "talking"? Not with words — but signals and supplies move from tree to tree, and the forest works like one big family. It sounds almost like justice: the strong help the weak. Next time you hug a tree, remember: under your feet, the forest is whispering.
blocks.title: 森林的悄悄话
blocks.cn: 森林真的在“说话”吗？不是用语言——但是信号和物资真的在树与树之间传递，整片森林就像一个大家庭。这听起来几乎像一种公平正义：强壮的帮助弱小的。下次你抱一抱大树时，别忘了：你的脚下，森林正在说悄悄话。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "once in a blue moon." A blue moon is a rare full moon, so this means: very rarely. Listen: my neighbour, Mr. Lee, washes his car once in a blue moon — maybe twice a year. But last Sunday it rained all morning — and Mr. Lee washed his car in the rain! "The rain is helping me," he laughed. And you? What do you do once in a blue moon — once a year, not once a fortnight?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“once in a blue moon”（千载难逢）：蓝月亮是一种罕见的满月，所以这个短语的意思是“非常非常难得”。听听这个小故事：我的邻居李先生洗车是千载难逢的事——一年顶多两次。可上周日下了一上午雨，李先生却在雨里洗起了车！“雨在帮我呢，”他笑着说。轮到你啦：你做什么事是千载难逢的——一年一次，而不是两周一次？

blocks.en: Let's think. The panda twins shared a frozen cake; the forest shared sugar and secrets. Two questions for you. First: if you made a birthday cake for an animal, which animal, and what flavour? Second: if the trees could send you one message, what would they say? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想一想。熊猫双胞胎分享了一块冰蛋糕，森林分享了糖和秘密。现在有两个问题问你。第一：如果你给一种动物做生日蛋糕，你会选哪种动物、做什么口味？第二：如果树木能给你发一条消息，你觉得它们会说什么？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Be kind like a mother tree, and sweet like a panda's birthday. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。要像大树妈妈一样善良，像熊猫的生日一样甜蜜。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:

A. A giant bamboo cake
B. A three-tier ice cake
C. A carrot sandwich
D. A honey pie

How much did Leni weigh when she was born?
A. About fifty kilos
B. About five kilos
C. Just one hundred and thirty-six grams
D. About one kilo

What do the fungi carry up to the trees?
A. Water and minerals
B. Sugar and leaves
C. Insects and warnings
D. Flowers and ice

What does "once in a blue moon" mean?
A. Every night
B. Very rarely
C. Twice a year
D. On your birthday

children.text: when 引导的时间状语从句
，意思是“当昆虫攻击一棵树时”。注意：when 从句里用
（attack），哪怕说的是将来会发生的事，也不用 will——这是 when 从句的铁规矩。
it sends a warning through the network
是介词短语，交代警告走的“路线”——通过网络。
a warning relevant to every neighbour
换个说法再讲一遍。其中
（与每一个邻居都相关）是形容词短语，太长了，所以
后面修饰它——英语里“形容词 + 介词短语”作定语时，习惯放在名词之后。
虫子进攻一棵树（when 从句，时间和条件）→ 这棵树发出警告（主干）→ 警告与每个邻居相关（同位语补清这个警告的重要性）
。一句话讲完森林报警的完整过程。
"a cake — a cake of ice! It had three tiers."
"Leni weighed just one hundred and thirty-six grams — about as much as an apple!"
"Fungi carry water and minerals up, and trees pay with sugar from their leaves."
. A blue moon is a rare full moon, so the idiom means something happens

words.clue: The day you were born — the twins celebrated theirs with an ice cake.
A very young tree, just growing from a seed.
Frozen water — the panda twins' birthday cake was made of it.
It shines in the night sky; a blue one is very rare.
Many parts joined together, passing things along — the forest hides a secret one.
The colour of the sky; together with 'moon', it means very rare.
A dark-red vegetable; its juice coloured the ice cake pink.
A black-and-white bear from China that loves bamboo.
To speak very quietly — the forest does it under the ground.
Living things like mushrooms; their tiny threads join tree roots together.
